Name: Handsome Farmer - HD portraits for Dialogue UI Unboxed
Author: ElinHime
Description:
[color=#f1c232][size=5][b]Handsome Farmer - HD portraits for Dialogue UI Unboxed[/b][/size][/color][size=4]
30 different farmer portraits for acharles1's Dialogue UI Unboxed - Immersive Dialogue Speech Bubbles.[/size]


[color=#f1c232][size=5][b]Installation: [/b][/size][/color][size=4]
[b]How to Use Custom Farmer Portraits:[/b][/size]
[size=4]Open the Farmer Portrait folder inside your DialogueUnboxed mod folder.
Delete the portraits that are already there.

Move the portrait you want to use from the Handsome Farmer Portrait file into the Farmer Portrait folder.
Remove the number from the filename so it's now named just Farmer.png[/size]

[size=4][b]Enable them ingame:[/b]
Open Generic Mod Config Menu (GMCM).
Select Dialogue UI Unboxed.
Turn ON Enable Farmer Portraits.

That's it!

[b][i]You can switch Farmer Portraits ON or OFF in GMCM at any time. Your portrait files won't be deleted or modified.[/i][/b][/size]

[size=4]Only base farmer portraits are included, not seasonal ones.
Be aware that the farmer's portrait only shows when your farmer has something to say.
